description: This file defines an Angular component for displaying a table of entities with features like pagination, sorting, filtering, and actions. It includes class definitions for the widget component and its data source, managing entity data retrieval, caching, and user interactions.

classes.name: EntitiesTableWidgetSettings
classes.description: Interface extending TableWidgetSettings with additional configuration options for entities table widget.

classes.name: EntitiesTableWidgetComponent
classes.description: Angular component for displaying and managing a table of entities with sorting, filtering, pagination, and actions.

classes.name: EntityDatasource
classes.description: Data source class for managing entity data retrieval, caching, and selection state for the entities table.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes widget settings, subscriptions, and config; sets up resize observer.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resize observer and subscriptions.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets up reactive filters, sorting, pagination, and triggers initial data load.

methods.name: onDataUpdated
methods.description: Refreshes data cache and triggers change detection.

methods.name: onEditModeChanged
methods.description: Adjusts UI when edit mode changes.

methods.name: pageLinkSortDirection
methods.description: Returns the sort direction for the page link.

methods.name: initializeConfig
methods.description: Sets up widget actions, columns, sorting, and styles based on settings.

methods.name: updateDatasources
methods.description: Configures columns, data keys, and data source based on widget settings.

methods.name: editColumnsToDisplay
methods.description: Opens overlay to select visible columns.

methods.name: enterFilterMode
methods.description: Enables text filter input mode.

methods.name: exitFilterMode
methods.description: Exits text filter input mode.

methods.name: updateData
methods.description: Triggers data reload with current sorting and pagination.

methods.name: trackByColumnDef
methods.description: Track function for columns.

methods.name: trackByEntityId
methods.description: Track function for entities.

methods.name: trackByActionCellDescriptionId
methods.description: Track function for action descriptors.

methods.name: headerStyle
methods.description: Returns style for column headers.

methods.name: rowStyle
methods.description: Returns observable style for a row.

methods.name: cellStyle
methods.description: Returns observable style for a cell.

methods.name: cellContent
methods.description: Returns observable HTML content for a cell.

methods.name: defaultContent
methods.description: Provides default cell content based on entity field type.

methods.name: onCellClick
methods.description: Handles cell click actions.

methods.name: columnHasCellClick
methods.description: Checks if a column has cell click actions.

methods.name: onRowClick
methods.description: Handles row click/double-click actions.

methods.name: onActionButtonClick
methods.description: Handles action button clicks.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears cached cell content and style data.
